Welcome to Obudu Mountain Resort. 

Obudu is unique as a world class resort and the jewel of the popular Cross River tourist region. Nestled on the picturesque plateau on the Oshie Ridge of the Sankwala Mountains. It is located 110 kilometers East of Ogoja, 65 kilometers from the town of Obudu and a five hour hike from the Cameroon border.

The gate, with its imposing ox-head and welcome notice, opens with a gentle feel of some hidden treasure that is out rightly intimidating.
At the base of the hills is located a breathtaking state of the art waterpark with facilities for swimming and water slides for children, teens and adults and tourists alike.

The Obudu WaterPark is an invitation to experience unequalled family fun at Obudus’s scenic environment. The Waterpark consists of swimming pool and, exciting water games, breath-taking slides, as well as other exciting attractions.

The hilltop (cattle ranch) is about 11KM of winded of elbow like shape road from the base and can be accessed by either the cable-car or the road. The ranch has numerous pleasant mountain-area and country-side views.

Obudu Resort arguably the most popular tourist centre in Nigeria has been variously described as a perfect marriage between Gods wonders of creation in conquering his environment.

The resort which is 24 square kilometres in size has capitalised on its altitude to provide guests with the best view points and fresh, invigorating mountain air.

With well over a 160 accommodation categories, comprising of standard rooms, executives, huts and chalets to a presidential apartment. Amidst its extreme ecotourism potentials, is room for other activities. Lovers of ecotourism and adventure, bored with the comfort of the hotel accommodations could easily get busy with a ride down the hill on the cable car and indulge in some water sports.

Very close to the reception is gallery that houses the  animal remains, e.g. cattle hones, African craft, spears, skins and beautifully designed calabash. This is the first place visitor from the cable car passes through to the other part of the resort.
Available is a cable car system which brings guests from the resort entrance at the bottom of the mountain to the ranch at the hill top, this is one of the longest cable car facilities in the world.

Seating on the altitude of 1,575.76 metres above sea level, the resort has a temperature of between 26°C to 32°C between November and January, and the nights are cool to cold during this period. Meanwhile, the lowest temperature ranges of 4°C to 10°C are recorded between June and September, which is the rainy season.
The ecosystem at the Resort presents a unique feature of interaction between man and nature.

A short walk takes you to the spectacular grotto. This natural swimming pool with sparkling pure water provides a clear view of the long winding waterfall and green mountain ranges surround the natural reserve.

A short walk takes you to the spectacular grotto. This natural swimming pool with sparkling pure water provides a clear view of the long winding waterfall and green mountain ranges surround the natural reserve.
This is the STEAK HOUSE, it provides all the refreshment needs of visitors at the resort. The steak house also has a lounge, bar and restaurant.

The lounge is equipped with state of the art facilities, giving visitors the pleasure of luxury. 

While at this place who know you may have the privilege of seeing the mountain chief who is a native of the mountains village.
Obudu possesses state of the art restaurants. The meals served at these restaurants are of international standard and the services are so well maintained that it can be compared to your home service.

The canopy walkway is about one of the most adventurous part of the resort, its span is about 100 meters from one end of the tower to the other and 50 meters high from the forest floor. The walkway allows tourists to experience a walk in the upper canopy of the forest. Free to move about unhindered, photographers, nature lovers, researchers, and tourist of all ages are amazed at the extraordinary diversity of canopy life and the breathtaking view from such height. It’s a totally different world in the tree canopy.

The Obudu Ranch Resort has 20 African bungalows, 20 Mountain Villas providing 60 rooms and a newly built International Conference Centre that can seat 250 persons. There is an Executive Board Room which can seat 30 persons, two Syndicate Rooms that can seat 40 persons each in addition to a posh restaurant, bar and an Internet Service Room.

Tucked away in the most serene and spectacular part of the resort is the Mountain Villa, located within the villa are brown wooded cabin apartments of different shapes and sizes, these cabin are all suspended about one to two meters from ground level. The presidential villa is also located at another section of this villa.  

Indeed, the ranch is a tourist haven with its inviting natural endowment to be explored. It's well equipped with modern facilities like an international hotel, an air-strip, intercom phones, gymnasium, tennis court, horse riding, bird watching etc.

The presidential villa is located on the highest peak of the Mountain Villa, at this sport visitors are treated to spectacular view of the resort, the Villa also has an Helipad for airlifting and landing.

This is about one of the highest peak at the Resort. At this point one will have a clear view of the spectacular spots within the resort such as the zigzag road leading to the hill top, the mountain villa, the serene and undulating landscape, the passing cable car, and the intermittent cloud movement . While taking a ride in the cable car one can ride in and out of clouds that are at various spots on the hill. 

The Resort is at an elevation of about 5,200 ft (1,576 m) above sea level, and enjoys a cool, temperate climate. It is an area of idyllic tranquillity, beautiful scenery and breathtaking view.
